user_config: ignored; exact CLI overrides recorded per call; auth inherited normally
sampling: CLI/provider defaults, not wire-verified; no claim of exact temperature or equal measured effective context budget

source.commit_url_status: 404; retrieved main bytes match previously frozen SHA-256
source.redistribution_status: not verified; local diagnostic only, no push authorized

selection.method: 10 smallest sha256(seed:id) within each A/B/C class, sorted by source id

conditions.shared: one fresh Luna formalization per case
conditions.M1: fresh Luna verdict with unchanged program, no executor evidence
conditions.M2: fresh Luna verdict with identical program and execution transcript

condition_order: alternate M1/M2 order by sorted case index
scoring: LLM final answer exact A/B/C vs source answer; invalid/missing stay in denominator 30; no solver-status substitution
isolation: fresh temporary cwd, ephemeral CLI, read-only native sandbox, ignore user config; reject any non-message/non-reasoning item event; trace-audited, not hermetic
budget_limit: same configured window, reasoning effort, deadline and calls per condition; actual token usage recorded, exact effective-budget equality unverified
formalization_audit: not independently human-audited; shared formalization isolates supplied evidence within this diagnostic, not end-to-end formalization quality
changes_from_luna_r4: original benchmark question replaces selected Horn subclaim
